entities.name: Modar Bejiri
entities.description: A blue vedalken of the Azorius Senate Elite Guard, promoted to field hussar, who hunts a shapeshifting murderer in Tin Street Market.

entities.name: Ashmane
entities.description: Modar's mount, which he summons with a click of his tongue.

entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: The Grand Arbiter of the Azorius Senate in the last days of the fraying Guildpact.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law-bound Ravnican guild that Modar serves; bound by the Guildpact against acting directly on guild members without a warrant.

entities.name: Prahv Senate Guard
entities.description: The Azorius soldiers guided by telepathic command who come to arrest Modar.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The law that binds Ravnica's guilds, here fraying, which prohibits direct action against a guild member without a signed warrant.

entities.name: Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius city containing the senate chamber.

entities.name: Tin Street Market
entities.description: A patchwork marketplace in the Tenth District where the murders and the final confrontation occur.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: The wilds of Ravnica where Modar planned to dispense Azorius justice.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane governed by the Guildpact.

events.summary: In the senate chamber of Grand Arbiter Augustin IV, Modar Bejiri advances to receive his field hussar's brooch.
events.quote: Modar Bejiri advanced to receive his field hussar's brooch

events.summary: The district imperator clasps the field hussar's brooch on Modar's cloak, completing his promotion.
events.quote: The district imperator unbuckled Modar's old signet brooch and clasped the field hussar's brooch in its place on his cloak.

events.summary: Riding Ashmane through Tin Street Market, Modar hears a man's last cry and finds blood in an alley.
events.quote: Even before he saw the crumpled body, Modar caught sight of dark, rolling lines of blood.

events.summary: Modar finds a woman in Boros uniform standing over an ogre's corpse, her hands dripping with blood.
events.quote: A woman in Boros uniform stood over an enormous corpse

events.summary: The shapeshifter takes the exact form of the dead ogre when Modar tries to stop her.
events.quote: she had taken the exact form of the victim

events.summary: Modar stabs the shapeshifter with his gladius but is struck on the cheek and loses his binding spell.
events.quote: Modar leaned in with the gladius, still hum-singing, and sank the blade up to the haft just below the ribcage.

events.summary: Modar slows the shapeshifter with a knight's charm, summons Ashmane, and tears his brooch free to escape.
events.quote: Just before the slow-spell ended, Modar reached out and tore the brooch free, and was off.

events.summary: The district imperator denies an arrest request because the Guildpact forbids direct action against a guild member without a warrant.
events.quote: The Guildpact prohibits direct action against the member of a guild, without a documented warrant signed by the presiding senators.

events.summary: Modar requests an emergency writ of arrest for himself, handing over his brooch as the relic of authority.
events.quote: Modar handed him the field hussar's brooch.

events.summary: Modar recalls watching the Prahv Senate Guard drill as an errand-runner, which inspired him to join the Azorius.
events.quote: Modar only learned after he had joined the Hussars that the Senate Guard was guided by telepathic command

events.summary: Returning to the alley, Modar finds the body and blood gone.
events.quote: the body was gone and the blood had vanished.

events.summary: Modar announces from the market stage that he is investigating deaths and has been given the rank of imperator, repeating his name to bait the shapeshifter.
events.quote: Then he repeated it again, and spelled his name clearly.

events.summary: The shapeshifter, now a troll, seizes Modar by the throat with Modar's own gladius at his chin.
events.quote: The troll grinned, produced a blade, and tucked it right under Modar's chin: it was Modar's gladius, clutched by the shapeshifter's gleaming black claws.

events.summary: An Azorius arrest team led by the district imperator tears the tent apart as Modar pulls the shapeshifter's claws into his chest while it takes his form.
events.quote: as the shapeshifter's bones began to rearrange themselves into the anatomy of a vedalken knight

relations.note: Court Hussar of the Prahv Senate Elite Guard promoted to Field Hussar
relations.quote: You have been selected for special dispensation by order of the Azorius Senate .

relations.note: acts under the Grand Arbiter's authority
relations.quote: under authority of Grand Arbiter Augustin IV

relations.note: Ashmane is his mount, which he summons with a click of the tongue
relations.quote: He clicked his tongue, summoning Ashmane, and climbed into the saddle.
